findings.evidenceJa: 桜と藤ねえを説得する
findings.governingReading: 桜と藤ねえを説得する requires agreement from both before he can lodge Sakura.
findings.explanation: Persuading Sakura and Taiga becomes persuading Taiga alone.

findings.evidenceJa: いささか買いすぎたきらいはある
findings.governingReading: 買いすぎたきらいはある describes a tendency/appearance of excess in this purchase; きらい is not 嫌い disliking something.
findings.explanation: Having perhaps bought too much becomes generally opposing overspending.

findings.highlight: Illya shoots a glance at the shopping bag in my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: ビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける
findings.governingReading: ビニール袋を手に describes Shirou; 睨みつける assigns his glare toward Illya, who only looks back curiously.
findings.explanation: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding shopping becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.

findings.highlight: she was in serious Master mode
findings.evidenceJa: 冷酷なマスターになった
findings.governingReading: 冷酷 repeats her threatening coldness from the preceding killing challenge.
findings.explanation: The ruthless Master becomes merely serious Master mode.

findings.highlight: I don't like forcing people to do things.
findings.evidenceJa: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから
findings.governingReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから locates the feared consequence in other people disliking her.
findings.explanation: Illya avoiding being disliked becomes a general aversion to forcing people.

findings.highlight: I don't even know how to feel about that!
findings.evidenceJa: 好きか嫌いかもないだろう
findings.governingReading: 人をぶった斬っておいて好きか嫌いかもないだろう says she cannot sensibly ask this after cutting him down.
findings.explanation: Rejecting the relevance of a like-or-dislike question becomes not knowing his own feelings.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは女の子な訳だし
findings.governingReading: 俺は年上 and イリヤは女の子 are separate stated reasons; the second adds gender rather than repeating the age premise.
findings.explanation: Her being a girl as his reason to give way becomes her being a kid.
